title: Sustainable CO2 bio-mitigation: a life cycle perspective on chemolithotrophic conversion in bubble column bioreactors
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5578-5588
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00936G, Communication
Rachael J. Barla, Suresh Gupta, Smita Raghuvanshi
A Life cycle assessment reveals the environmental viability of Bacillus cereus to convert industrial CO2 emissions into biodiesel and identifies biomass productivity, dewatering, and homogenization as factors for sustainable biofuels production.
